definitions.explanation: A large crowd of people moving like waves, especially the flow of a dense throng in a busy place.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}は{人波|ひとなみ}であふれていた。
examples.english: The station was overflowing with a sea of people.

examples.japanese: {人波|ひとなみ}にのまれて{友人|ゆうじん}を{見失|みうしな}った。
examples.english: I was swept up in the crowd and lost sight of my friend.

examples.japanese: {花火大会|はなびたいかい}の{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}は、{駅|えき}まで{続|つづ}く{人波|ひとなみ}でなかなか{進|すす}めなかった。
examples.english: On the way back from the fireworks show, the wave of people stretching to the station made it hard to move.

notes:
Compound of {人|ひと} (people) + {波|なみ} (wave). A vivid image of a crowd flowing and surging like the sea.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人波|ひとなみ}にのまれる: to be swallowed up by the crowd
- {人波|ひとなみ}をかき{分|わ}ける: to push through the crowd
- {人波|ひとなみ}が{押|お}し{寄|よ}せる: a wave of people surges in

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人|ひと}ごみ: crowd; throng — the most common everyday word, emphasizes congestion
- {群衆|ぐんしゅう}: crowd; multitude — more formal, a mass of gathered people
